title: Step 3 - Using Scikit-Learn's Predict Method for Linear Regression in Python

cues.en: -: Hello my friends.
cues.zh: 各位朋友，大家好。

cues.en: All right, so how did you do with the little exercise here?
cues.zh: 剛才的小練習做得如何？

cues.en: Predicting the test set results.
cues.zh: 也就是預測測試集結果。

cues.en: So based on what we've just done in the previous tutorial, you know when training the simple linear regression model on the training set, and also based on the hint I gave you, you know, this predict method,
cues.zh: 根據上一堂課在訓練集上訓練簡單線性迴歸的做法，以及我給的 predict 方法提示，

cues.en: well you should have been able to crack this.
cues.zh: 你應該已經能解出來。

cues.en: All right, so now we're gonna implement the solution together, starting by creating this new code cell.
cues.zh: 現在一起實作解答，先建立新的程式儲存格。

cues.en: All right, so first let's just explain what we want to do here.
cues.zh: 先說明這裡要做什麼。

cues.en: We wanna predict the results of the observations in the test set.
cues.zh: 我們要預測測試集中各筆觀測值的結果。

cues.en: And so, let me show you once again the data set.
cues.zh: 再看一次資料集。

cues.en: So that's the whole data set containing the 30 observations.
cues.zh: 完整資料集共有 30 筆觀測值。

cues.en: And we actually splitted this data set into the training set and the test set.
cues.zh: 已經分成訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: The test size was chosen to be 0.2, meaning that 20% of all these observations went into the test set.
cues.zh: test_size 設為 0.2，也就是 20% 的觀測值進入測試集。

cues.en: So 20% of 30 is actually six.
cues.zh: 30 的 20% 就是六筆。

cues.en: So let's say, just to simplify the explanation, that the observations of the test set are the last six ones, you know, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6.
cues.zh: 為了方便說明，先假設測試集是最後六筆，一、二、三、四、五、六。

cues.en: So let's say all these observations went into the test set.
cues.zh: 假設這些觀測值都進入測試集。

cues.en: Well, what we wanna do now is predict for each of these observations, meaning for each of these employees, the salary.
cues.zh: 現在要預測的，就是每一筆，也就是每位員工的薪資。

cues.en: Right?
cues.zh: 對吧？

cues.en: So what we're gonna input in that predict method is exactly the number of years of experience for each of these six employees.
cues.zh: 因此，predict 裡要傳入的，是這六位員工各自的工作年資。

cues.en: And our moral will predict the salaries.
cues.zh: 模型就會預測薪資。

cues.en: So the salaries that we see here, you know, the last six ones are the exact salaries, you know the truth.
cues.zh: 這裡最後六筆薪資，是實際薪資，也就是真實答案。

cues.en: We call it the ground truth.
cues.zh: 我們稱為 ground truth。

cues.en: And when calling the predict method on these six numbers of years of experience, we will get six predicted salaries.
cues.zh: 針對這六個年資呼叫 predict，就會得到六筆預測薪資。

cues.en: And so what we'll wanna do then will be to compare the predicted salaries to these real six salaries, okay?
cues.zh: 接下來，把預測薪資與這六筆實際薪資比較。

cues.en: And we will do that in the last steps of this implementation when visualizing not only the test set results, but also the training set results.
cues.zh: 這會在最後的視覺化步驟完成，不只看測試集，也會看訓練集。

cues.en: You are gonna see, everything will be super clear.
cues.zh: 你會看到，一切都非常清楚。

cues.en: All right, so let's do this.
cues.zh: 現在開始。

cues.en: Let's get the test set results by first, you know, in order to call a method, we first need to call the object itself, which is regressor.
cues.zh: 要取得測試集結果，先取出物件本身 regressor，才能呼叫方法。

cues.en: So that was the first step you had to do here.
cues.zh: 這是第一步。

cues.en: Then from our object, we add a dot here, and we call the function we want.
cues.zh: 物件後面加句點，再呼叫要用的函式。

cues.en: Oh wow.
cues.zh: 哇。

cues.en: It's funny, the Google Colab actually guessed what I was about to call.
cues.zh: 很有趣，Google Colab 居然猜到我要呼叫什麼。

cues.en: That's, I never noticed that.
cues.zh: 我以前沒注意過。

cues.en: But anyway, yeah, that's perfect.
cues.zh: 總之，很方便。

cues.en: We want to use the predict method, of course.
cues.zh: 當然，要使用 predict。

cues.en: That was the hint.
cues.zh: 這就是剛才的提示。

cues.en: And this predict method, you know, as any function expects some arguments, and so now according to you, what did we have to input in this predict method?
cues.zh: 和任何函式一樣，predict 也需要引數，你認為應該傳入什麼？

cues.en: Well that's simple, once again, you know, we want to enter the features, meaning numbers of years of experience and not the salaries.
cues.zh: 很簡單，要傳入特徵，也就是工作年資，而不是薪資。

cues.en: That was just for the training set.
cues.zh: 薪資只有訓練時才需要。

cues.en: Here, we only need the numbers of experience because from the numbers of experience we want to predict the salaries.
cues.zh: 這裡只需要工作年資，因為要根據年資預測薪資。

cues.en: And the numbers of experience are exactly contained in X test, right?
cues.zh: 年資就存在 X_test 裡。

cues.en: Because we want the numbers of experience of the test set.
cues.zh: 因為現在要的是測試集中員工的年資。

cues.en: And so the only thing we had to input here is X test.
cues.zh: 所以只要傳入 X_test。

cues.en: And there you go.
cues.zh: 完成。

cues.en: That was the solution.
cues.zh: 這就是解答。

cues.en: Okay? So as you can see, once again, very easy.
cues.zh: 可以看到，同樣非常簡單。

cues.en: That's the beauty of the libraries.
cues.zh: 這就是函式庫的好處。

cues.en: You can just do anything you want in usually one or two or three lines of code.
cues.zh: 通常只要一、二、三行程式，就能完成想做的事。

cues.en: And here, we just had to call the predict method to make some predictions from a model that is, of course, already trained on the training set.
cues.zh: 這裡只需要呼叫 predict，就能用已經在訓練集上訓練好的模型做預測。

cues.en: All right, now, because we're gonna visualize then the training set results and the test set results, I'm actually going to put all these predictions,
cues.zh: 接下來要把訓練集與測試集結果視覺化，所以我想把這些預測結果，

cues.en: because this returns actually a vector of predictions, you know, a vector containing the predicted salaries of the employees in the test set.
cues.zh: 也就是函式傳回、包含測試集員工預測薪資的向量，

cues.en: So I would like to put all these predicted salaries in a vector, therefore in a new variable.
cues.zh: 存到一個新的變數中。

cues.en: And therefore here, I'm creating this new variable, which I'm calling Y-pred, you know, as opposed to Y-test, which contains the real salaries.
cues.zh: 因此建立 y_pred，和包含實際薪資的 y_test 做區別。

cues.en: So make sure to understand Y-test here contains the real salaries, and Y-pred here contains the predicted salaries.
cues.zh: 務必理解，y_test 是實際薪資，y_pred 是預測薪資。

cues.en: And now in the next steps, we're gonna compare Y-pred to Y-test.
cues.zh: 後面的步驟會比較 y_pred 與 y_test。

cues.en: And also we'll compare Y-train to the predicted salaries in the training set.
cues.zh: 也會比較 y_train 與訓練集的預測薪資。

cues.en: And the last two steps of this implementation, visualizing the training set results, and visualizing the test set results.
cues.zh: 最後兩步就是將訓練集與測試集結果視覺化。

cues.en: We will get amazing graphs, super clear, super simple to understand, and we will clearly see how well our model was trained with this visualization, and how well our model was able to predict new observations
cues.zh: 會得到非常清楚、簡單易懂的圖，一張看模型訓練得好不好，另一張看它對新觀測值的

cues.en: with this visualization.
cues.zh: 預測表現。

cues.en: So let's do this in the next tutorial.
cues.zh: 我們下一堂課來做。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
